name: gmail-tools
description: Gmail as code: archive statement and receipt PDFs by month, manage filters from a TOML file with lint and backfill, and triage the inbox

home.title: gmail-tools home folder
home.description: Folder for your credentials, tokens, .env, targets.toml, filters.toml and archived data. Leave empty to use $GMAIL_TOOLS_HOME or ~/.config/gmail-tools. Keep it out of synced folders.
